blurb: Piedra River Anglers offers guided fly fishing trips targeting trout, northern pike, and common carp on various waters including rivers, streams, lakes, and reservoirs near Pagosa Springs, Colorado. Options include wade trips, kick tube trips, drift boat fishing, float trips, and ice fishing. They also offer private and public water access, with additional private land fees for some trips.
